newsitem.title: USA: Keystone says shareholders okay merger.
newsitem.headline: Keystone says shareholders okay merger.

text.p: Keystone Automotive Industries Inc on Monday said its shareholders approved the proposed merger with North Star Plating Co at a special meeting of shareholders on Friday, March 21, 1997.
Keystone Automotive and North Star are distributors of aftermarket automotive collision repair parts.

As a result of the merger, Keystone will have 67 service centers in 31 states with North Star maintaining its name in its 20 locations. Prior to the merger, Keystone had 47 service centers in 26 states.
